format_note: Foundry scenario catalog. Custom format, not an AiEvaluationDefinition. Feeds the static audit runner, the test spec converter, and manual Testing Center runs. Apex expectations describe ServiceTriageAction output for the scenario input (final user turn when turns are present). Agent expectations describe Service_Triage_Agent behavior: run_triage scores via the Apex action, clarify asks one targeted question, redirect politely declines off topic chat, escalate recommends human follow up (v1 never transfers). Nothing here has executed against a live agent yet.

live_targets.note: Targets for a future live run. Not results. No live run has happened.
